Private Banking & HNI Relationship Manager Job at Sterling Bank Plc




        
    

        
        Sterling Bank Plc "Your one-customer bank" is a full service national commercial bank in Nigeria. In over 50 years of operations, Sterling Bank (formerly NAL Bank) has evolved from the nation’s pre-eminent investment banking institution to a fully-fledged commercial bank; and completed a merger with 4 other banks - Indo-Nigeria Merchant Bank, Magnum Trust Bank, NBM Bank and Trust Bank of Africa - as part of the 2006 consolidation of the Nigerian banking industry.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Private Banking & HNI Relationship Manager

Job Location: Lagos

Role Description
     

            
    




	This is a full-time, on-site role based in Lagos State, Nigeria for Private Banking & HNI Relationship Managers.
	The role involves managing and growing relationships with high-net-worth individuals (HNIs) and private banking clients, including understanding their financial goals and providing tailored banking and investment solutions.
	Responsibilities include proactive client engagement, portfolio review and optimization, cross-selling suitable bank products, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
	The role also requires monitoring market trends, identifying new business opportunities, preparing proposals and reports, and maintaining high standards of compliance and risk management.
	Relationship Managers are expected to deliver exceptional client experiences, contribute to revenue growth, and uphold the bank’s values in every interaction.


Qualifications


	Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field; advanced certifications (e.g., CFA, CFP) are an advantage.
	Strong Business Relationship Management skills, including client acquisition, retention, and stakeholder engagement.
	Proficiency in Financial Planning to assess client needs, set goals, and design comprehensive wealth and banking solutions.
	Experience in Portfolio Management with the ability to monitor, rebalance, and optimize client portfolios for risk and return.
	Solid understanding of Finance and Investments, including banking products, capital markets, and wealth management strategies.
	Proven experience in private banking, wealth management, or HNI relationship management within financial services.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer focus and ethical mindset.
	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, meet targets, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Purpose
     

            
    




	We are in need of an experienced recovery officer within the financial services and banking sector to join our team.
	To ensure timely recovery of overdue loans and minimize the organization’s credit losses by implementing effective debt recovery strategies, maintaining positive customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.


Key Responsibilities


	Monitor loan repayment schedules and identify delinquent accounts.
	Contact borrowers through phone calls, emails, letters, and physical visits to recover outstanding debts.
	Negotiate repayment plans and restructuring arrangements with defaulting customers where necessary.
	Maintain accurate records of all recovery activities and customer interactions.
	Investigate reasons for loan defaults and recommend appropriate recovery actions.
	Prepare and issue demand notices and recovery letters to delinquent borrowers.
	Coordinate with legal officers and external recovery agents on difficult recovery cases.
	Track and report recovery performance, arrears status, and collection trends.
	Ensure compliance with internal credit policies, regulatory guidelines, and ethical collection practices.
	Conduct field visits for verification and recovery of overdue loans.
	Recommend write-offs, repossession, or legal action where recovery prospects are limited to management.
	Maintain confidentiality of customer information and company records.


Educational background & skills


	Bachelor’s degree in law, finance or accounting
	2:1 from a recognized university
	5-10 years of experience in loan recovery, credit risk, and management
	A certification in CIBN is an added advantage
	Strong negotiation and persuasion skills
	Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

	Ability to handle difficult customers professionally.
	Good report writing and documentation skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and loan management systems.

	Combination of office-based and field recovery activities.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Content Creator",
  "description": "Eden Solutions &amp; Resources Limited is a leading Human Resource and Business Consulting firm committed to helping organizations build stronger teams, improve operational efficiency, and achieve sustainable&nbsp;business growth. Established in 2002, Eden Solutions &amp; Resources has grown from a recruitment-focused organization into a comprehensive professional services firm providing strategic solutions across Human Resources,&nbsp;Recruitment, HR Outsourcing, Training and Development, Background Screening, Organizational Development, Employee Leasing, Bookkeeping, Benefits Administration, and Business Support. Our approach is built around a simple principle: organizations perform better when they have the right people, the right systems, and the right strategies in place.

We work with businesses across different sectors to understand their unique organizational challenges and provide practical, customized solutions that address their immediate needs while supporting long-term growth. From identifying and attracting high-quality talent to developing employees, strengthening HR systems, managing outsourced workforce functions, and supporting organizational transformation, we provide solutions designed to create measurable value for our clients.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Content Creator

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking a creative, confident and commercially minded Content Creator to develop compelling content that positions our real estate brand strongly in the market, showcases properties effectively and generates meaningful audience engagement and leads.
	The ideal candidate should understand how to create content that does more than attract views. They must be able to use video, photography, storytelling and social media strategy to present properties, communicate their value and support sales and business growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute engaging content for the company&rsquo;s social media platforms, website and other digital channels.
	Create high quality property videos, walkthroughs, reels, short form videos, promotional videos and photographs for residential and commercial properties.
	Visit properties and capture compelling visual content that highlights their features, location, amenities and investment potential.
	Develop creative concepts and storylines for real estate campaigns, property launches and promotional activities.
	Write engaging captions, scripts, property descriptions and other marketing copy.
	Appear in videos where required and confidently present properties, locations and real estate opportunities to prospective clients.
	Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to develop content aligned with current property listings, campaigns and sales objectives.
	Create content specifically designed to generate enquiries, leads, property viewings and conversions.
	Manage and maintain a consistent content calendar across relevant social media platforms.
	Monitor social media trends, emerging content formats and competitor activities within the real estate market.
	Edit videos and photographs to a professional standard using appropriate content creation and editing tools.
	Develop creative content around real estate education, investment opportunities, market trends, home ownership and property lifestyle.
	Cover property inspections, exhibitions, client events, site visits and other company activities.
	Repurpose existing content into different formats suitable for various digital platforms.
	Track content performance and provide insights on engagement, reach, audience growth and lead generation.
	Continuously test new creative approaches to improve the performance of the company&#39;s digital content.


Requirements


	Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in content creation, digital marketing, social media or a related field.
	Proven experience creating short-form video content, particularly Reels, TikTok and similar formats.
	Experience creating content for real estate, property, construction, luxury lifestyle or other commercially driven brands is highly advantageous.
	Strong photography and videography skills.
	Proficiency with video editing and graphic design tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop or equivalent platforms.
	Strong understanding of social media platforms and current content trends.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Ability to write compelling scripts, captions and marketing copy.
	Confident personality and ability to appear naturally on camera.
	Strong sense of visual aesthetics, creativity and storytelling.
	Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and manage multiple content projects.
	Must be willing to travel to property locations when required.


Key Competencies:


	Creativity: Ability to consistently develop fresh and commercially relevant content ideas.
	Visual Storytelling: Ability to turn properties and real estate opportunities into compelling visual stories.
	Commercial Awareness: Understanding that content should contribute to brand growth, enquiries and sales.
	Communication: Excellent presentation, writing and interpersonal skills.
	Social Media Intelligence: Strong understanding of what drives reach, engagement and audience growth.
	Attention to Detail: High standards for video quality, photography, editing, captions and brand presentation.
	Proactivity: Ability to identify content opportunities without waiting for detailed instructions.


What We Are Looking For:


	We are looking for someone who is creative, energetic, camera-confident, and commercially aware. The successful candidate should have a strong portfolio demonstrating their ability to create professional video and social media content.
	Female candidates are particularly encouraged to apply.
	Applicants should submit their CV together with a portfolio, social media page or samples of previous content created.


Salary
N200,000 - N300,000 monthly.&nbsp;

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: recruiter1@edensrpeople.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Content Creator

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are seeking a creative, confident and commercially minded Content Creator to develop compelling content that positions our real estate brand strongly in the market, showcases properties effectively and generates meaningful audience engagement and leads.
	The ideal candidate should understand how to create content that does more than attract views. They must be able to use video, photography, storytelling and social media strategy to present properties, communicate their value and support sales and business growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute engaging content for the company’s social media platforms, website and other digital channels.
	Create high quality property videos, walkthroughs, reels, short form videos, promotional videos and photographs for residential and commercial properties.
	Visit properties and capture compelling visual content that highlights their features, location, amenities and investment potential.
	Develop creative concepts and storylines for real estate campaigns, property launches and promotional activities.
	Write engaging captions, scripts, property descriptions and other marketing copy.
	Appear in videos where required and confidently present properties, locations and real estate opportunities to prospective clients.
	Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to develop content aligned with current property listings, campaigns and sales objectives.
	Create content specifically designed to generate enquiries, leads, property viewings and conversions.
	Manage and maintain a consistent content calendar across relevant social media platforms.
	Monitor social media trends, emerging content formats and competitor activities within the real estate market.
	Edit videos and photographs to a professional standard using appropriate content creation and editing tools.
	Develop creative content around real estate education, investment opportunities, market trends, home ownership and property lifestyle.
	Cover property inspections, exhibitions, client events, site visits and other company activities.
	Repurpose existing content into different formats suitable for various digital platforms.
	Track content performance and provide insights on engagement, reach, audience growth and lead generation.
	Continuously test new creative approaches to improve the performance of the company's digital content.


Requirements


	Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in content creation, digital marketing, social media or a related field.
	Proven experience creating short-form video content, particularly Reels, TikTok and similar formats.
	Experience creating content for real estate, property, construction, luxury lifestyle or other commercially driven brands is highly advantageous.
	Strong photography and videography skills.
	Proficiency with video editing and graphic design tools such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Photoshop or equivalent platforms.
	Strong understanding of social media platforms and current content trends.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Ability to write compelling scripts, captions and marketing copy.
	Confident personality and ability to appear naturally on camera.
	Strong sense of visual aesthetics, creativity and storytelling.
	Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and manage multiple content projects.
	Must be willing to travel to property locations when required.


Key Competencies:


	Creativity: Ability to consistently develop fresh and commercially relevant content ideas.
	Visual Storytelling: Ability to turn properties and real estate opportunities into compelling visual stories.
	Commercial Awareness: Understanding that content should contribute to brand growth, enquiries and sales.
	Communication: Excellent presentation, writing and interpersonal skills.
	Social Media Intelligence: Strong understanding of what drives reach, engagement and audience growth.
	Attention to Detail: High standards for video quality, photography, editing, captions and brand presentation.
	Proactivity: Ability to identify content opportunities without waiting for detailed instructions.


What We Are Looking For:


	We are looking for someone who is creative, energetic, camera-confident, and commercially aware. The successful candidate should have a strong portfolio demonstrating their ability to create professional video and social media content.
	Female candidates are particularly encouraged to apply.
	Applicants should submit their CV together with a portfolio, social media page or samples of previous content created.


Salary
N200,000 - N300,000 monthly.
